document.title: Package TectD MCP into a new owned output directory
document.canonical_text: Use scripts/package-codex-plugin.py with an explicitly selected built tectd-mcp binary and a new output parent. The result is output-parent/tectd. Existing output is refused. Packaging does not install the plugin or operate the daemon/database.
conditions: Declared pinned source contract; no installed-runtime claim.

snapshot.title: Pinned TectD package source contract
snapshot.text:
Independent plugin ID and MCP server key: `tectd`. Display name: **TectD MCP**.
MCP `serverInfo.name` and executable: `tectd-mcp`. This package does not replace
`tect@tect-local` or its `tect-dynamic-materialization` server.

The source template is packaged together with a built binary by
`scripts/package-codex-plugin.py --binary /absolute/tectd-mcp --output /absolute/new-parent`.
The output is `new-parent/tectd`; an existing output is refused. No installation,
marketplace mutation, daemon startup, migration or enrollment is performed.

document.authority_basis: Owner-authorized source-only DK-2 acceptance in an isolated fixture

runbook.purpose_and_fit: Build a reviewable package from the exact source template and selected binary.
prerequisites: selected binary/source identity known and output absent
runbook.required_authority: Create only the task-owned package output.

steps.action: Inspect binary/source identity and output absence

steps.expected_result: selected binary and explicit configuration boundary

runbook.failure_and_recovery: Stop on mismatched input or existing output; do not overwrite; use a new owned output only under current authority.
